ἰακώβ.en: Ἰακώβ (nome próprio): Jacob, pr. name, indecl. Son of Issac, Matt 1:2. Father of Joseph, Mary’s husband, Matt…

ἰδού.en: ἰδού word aorist middle imperative of εἶδον used as an interjection, Look! See! Lo! Mt. 1:23

ἰσραήλ.en: Ἰσραήλ (nome próprio): Israel, pr. name, indecl.

ἰσχύς.en: ἰσχύς word strength, might, power, Rev. 18:2

ἵστημι.en: ἵστημι word pluperfect, ἑστάμην, also formed as στήκω 10x, trans. to make to stand, set, place, M…

ὀπίσω.en: ὀπίσω (preposição): can function as an improper prep., behind, after, at one’s back, Mt. 4:10

ὀργή.en: ὀργή word pr. mental bent, impulse

ὁ.en: ὁ (preposição): the prepositive article, answering, to a considerable extent, to the English definite a…

ὁρμάω.en: ὁρμάω word pr. trans. to put in motion, incite

ὁράω.en: ὁράω word pluperfect, ἑωράκειν, some list εἶδον as the second aorist of ὁράω, to see, behold, Mt.…

ὄρος.en: ὄρος word a mountain, hill, Mt. 5:1, 14

ὅδε.en: ὅδε word this, that, he, she, it, Lk. 10:39

ὅλος.en: ὅλος word all, whole, entire, Mt. 1:22

ὅς.en: ὅς word who, which, what, that, Mt. 1:16, 23, 25

ὅτι.en: ὅτι (partícula): originally was the neuter of ὅστις, that, Mt. 2:16, 22, 23

ὑπομένω.en: ὑπομένω (partícula): intrans. to remain or stay behind, when others have departed, Lk. 2:43

ὑπόστασις.en: ὑπόστασις word pr. a standing under

ὠδίν.en: ὠδίν word the spasms or pains, of a woman in travail, a birth pang, 1 Thess. 5:3

ὡς.en: ὡς (pronome): conjunction formed from the relative pronoun ὅς, used as a comparative part. and conj.,…

ῥομφαία.en: ῥομφαία word pr. a Thracian broad-sword

ῥάβδος.en: ῥάβδος word a rod, wand, Heb. 9:4
